Synthetic brake photograph generated by 12ui for the inspection-media acceptance journey. It is test input only; the app contains no sample media or seeded findings.

`synthetic-inspection.webm` is a one-second, silent 160×90 blue VP9 clip generated with `ffmpeg -f lavfi -i color=c=blue:s=160x90:r=10 -t 1 -c:v libvpx-vp9 -an -threads 1 synthetic-inspection.webm`. It proves playback of reviewed DVI media without real customer imagery.
